director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge—cricket ground ke boundary run jitna. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Aaj hum kisi shape ke chaaron taraf ka poora kinaara naapenge. Cricket ki pitch socho, lagbhag 20 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Ek kone se chalo, kinaare-kinaare poori pitch ghoomo aur wapas wahin aa jao. Jitna chale, utna pitch ka parimap hai.
haan samajh gayi

Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain, 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone par ungli rakho aur kinaare par chalao: pehli bhuja, doosri, teesri, aur wapas usi kone par. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Toh ungli kul kitne cm chali?
director.card: Toh ungli kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Aao, isko ek naye dhang se dekhein. Ab ek naya khet, kone P, Q, R, S, T. P par ungli rakho aur har bhuja ka naam lo jaise-jaise uski lambai jodte ho. Ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh jod adhoora. Jod tabhi poora hota hai jab tum wapas P par pahunchte ho. Yahan tak saaf hai?
thoda hindi mein samjhao

Theek hai, main yeh Hindi mein bolti hoon. Har bhuja par ungli rakho aur uska naam lo. Jo bhuja bol di, uski lambai jod do. Khet PQRST ki paanch bhujayein hain: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Khet ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?
director.card: Khet PQRST ki paanch bhujayein hain: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Khet ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

director.text: 26 m nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. P se shuru karo aur PQ, QR, RS, ST, TP bolte jao. TP ke baad tum wapas P par ho. 8 m, 5 m, 7 m, 6 m aur 3 m bhujaon wale khet PQRST ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?
director.card: Khet PQRST ki paanch bhujayein hain: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Khet ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
Is sawaal ka jawab 29 m hai, kyunki P se wapas P tak paanchon bhujayein: 8 + 5 + 7 + 6 + 3 = 29 m. Yahan tak theek hai?
drawing karke samjhao
Is aakaar ki 5 bhujayein seedhi karke ek rekha par rakhi hain: 8 m, 5 m, 7 m, 6 m, 3 m.
haan samajh gayi
Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Toh ungli kul kitne cm chali?
director.card: Toh ungli kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: 9 cm
Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Iska jawab 15 cm hai, kyunki 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
pata nahi, aap batao
Yahan sahi jawab 15 cm hai, kyunki 4 aur 5 se 9 hua, aur 9 mein 6 aur jodo toh 15 cm; 6 chhod dete toh sirf 9 cm, yaani kinaara adhoora. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan

Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare ka hissa hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: pehle main try karun?
Haan, pehle tum try karo. Toh suno, sawaal yeh hai. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 30 centimetres

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki chhah bhujayein, har ek 5 cm ki: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: upar 6, bagal ki bhuja 4, neeche 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 20 cm

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, dhaaga sirf kinaare par chalta hai: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 cm. Phoolon ki ek kyari triangle jaisi hai, uski bhujayein 7 m, 9 m aur 12 m hain. Uske kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Kitni lambi baad lagegi?
aapko virat pasand hai?

Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Pehla kadam dekho. Baad kinaare par lagegi, toh teeno bhujayein jodni hain: P = 7 + 9 + 12, kyunki ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh baad mein wahan khaali jagah reh jaayegi. Yahan tak theek hai?
sixer, jab ball seedha bahar jaati hai
Sixer ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh chakkar khatam ho jaaye. Pehle 7 aur 9 jodo: 7 + 9 = 16 m, kyunki do bhujayein ho gayi, teesri abhi baaki hai.
theek hai
Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?
director.card: Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
16 m mein abhi sirf do bhujayein hain, 7 m aur 9 m. Teesri bhuja 12 m bhi kinaare par hai, use bhi jodna hai. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?
director.card: Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?

director.text: 28 m hai na
Haan, sahi hai. Toh poora jawab: kyari ke liye 28 m baad lagegi, kyunki baad ko teeno kinaaron par chalna hai, ek bhi bhuja chhoot nahi sakti. Sixer mein tumhe kya karna sabse achha lagta hai?
batting karna

Achha, toh tumhara favourite hai batting karna. Ab wahin wapas aate hain jahan hum the. Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain. Ek kone se ghoomo toh: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Usi kone par wapas pahunchne tak kitne metre chaloge?
director.card: Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain. Ek kone se ghoomo toh: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Usi kone par wapas pahunchne tak kitne metre chaloge?

j2.line: Achha, toh tumhara favourite hai batting karna.

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 26 m
Bilkul sahi. Dekho, chaaron bhujayein judti hain: 9 + 6 + 7 + 4 = 26 m. Zoya ne kaha ki 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ke kinaare par 10 × 4 = 40 cm tape lagegi. Sahi mein kitne cm tape lagegi?
director.card: Zoya ne kaha ki 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ke kinaare par 10 × 4 = 40 cm tape lagegi. Sahi mein kitne cm tape lagegi?

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki tape kinaare par chalti hai: 10 + 4 + 10 + 4 = 28 cm; 10 × 4 andar ki jagah hai. Seedhi bhujaon wali har shape mein har bhuja jodna chalta hai. Ab ek rectangle socho: iski bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, aur wahin se ek chhota raasta milta hai.
haan samajh gayi

Is rectangle mein upar aur neeche wali bhuja 10 m ki hai, woh lambai hai. Daayein-baayein wali 6 m ki, woh chaudai. Aamne-saamne ki bhujayein barabar hoti hain. Board par 10 aur 6 ek-ek baar likhe hain, par chakkar lagao toh dono do-do baar milte hain. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan
Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?
director.card: Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

director.text: 16 m sahi nahi hai. Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Cheenti ek kone se chalti hai, saath mein ek counter ginti karta hai. Pehle lambai chali, phir chaudai: ab woh saamne wale kone par hai, bas aadha raasta. Lambai + chaudai yahin tak hai. Ghar abhi do bhujayein door hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe nahi pata
Saamne wala kona ghar nahi hai. Cheenti ko abhi do bhujayein aur chalni hain. Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Uska counter kitna dikhayega?
director.card: Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Uska counter kitna dikhayega?

director.text: 54 metre
Haan, sahi hai, kyunki do lambai aur do chaudai: 2 × (19 + 8) = 54 m. Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?
director.card: Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

director.text: Bilkul sahi. Dekho, 10 aur 6 dono do-do baar aate hain: 10 + 6 + 10 + 6 = 32 m. Naya rectangle: 12 m lamba, 5 m chauda. Neeche baayein kone se chalo, 12 m aage, phir 5 m upar. Ab tum bilkul saamne wale kone par ho, yaani aadha raasta. Baaki aadha bhi utna hi lamba hai. Isliye parimap = 2 × (lambai + chaudai). Yahan tak saaf hai?
thak gayi, bye
Theek hai Riya, tum thak gayi ho. Chun sakti ho: aage badhein, thoda viraam lein, ya aaj ke liye rok dein.
